address: 15 rue du Docteur-Bigois, La Rochelle, 17000, France
bio: Jemmy Brouet, formerly of Le Jules Vernes (Alain Ducasse), is behind this chic bistro with red brick features and sunny colours. The Menu du Marché is very reasonably priced (and more ambitious in the evening); vegetarian option. Slightly out of the centre, but easy to get to....
